Apple is celebrating the 30th anniversary of Pokémon with a collection of original wallpapers for iPhone. There are four total, including one designed for iPhone Duo.

Apple celebrates 30th anniversary of Pokémon with new wallpapers, more

Pokémon turns 30 this year, and Apple is joining in the celebration with some fun collaborations.

Most notably for users around the world, Apple has created several original wallpapers for iPhone that are available for download below.

Applin, the Pokémon that looks like an apple, is unsurprisingly central to the wallpapers.

One of the Applin variants is also available in a special iPhone Duo size:

Beyond these wallpapers, Apple Stores in Japan are selling a special gift card featuring Applin, and feature several other promotional elements during the celebration. The promotion runs through November 30.

Earlier this year, Apple’s then-CEO Tim Cook and current CEO John Ternus hosted Pikachu and The Pokémon Company’s CEO at Apple Park. You can read our coverage on that visit here.
